page_title: Feelings Wheel — Name What You're Feeling · Emoton

seo.h1: Feelings wheel: name what you're feeling
seo.intro_p: Emoton is a free interactive feelings wheel — an emotional check-in you can do in under a minute. Touch your “I”, see what's most alive right now, and pick the word closest to it. No sign-up, no account, nothing saved.
seo.how_h2: How to name what you're feeling
seo.how_p: Not sure what am I feeling? Start broad — choose the area that's loudest, then the shade nearest to it. Naming your feeling is the whole practice: putting a feeling into words already changes how it sits.
seo.bewith_h2: Be with it — not fix it
seo.bewith_p: Once you've named it, you can simply be with an emotion — let it be here for a moment instead of fixing it or pushing it away. That's how to sit with your feelings: not solving, just keeping it company.
seo.felt_p: Emoton works with felt states, not diagnoses. It never reads, scores, or labels you — you name what you feel, and the tool only holds the space. If you continue into a practice, the camera reads pulse only, on your device.

faq.a: A circular map of emotions you pick from to find the word closest to what you feel.

faq.q: How do I know what I'm feeling?
faq.a: Start broad: choose the area that's loudest right now, then the shade nearest. It doesn't have to be exact.
Yes — no account, no sign-up, nothing is saved.

faq.q: Does it analyse or diagnose my emotions?
faq.a: No. Emoton never reads, scores, or labels you. You name what you feel; it just holds the space.
Instead of fixing or pushing a feeling away, you let it be here a moment. Often that's what it was waiting for.

faq.q: Do I have to turn on my camera?
faq.a: Only if you choose a practice, and it reads pulse only, on your device.

presence.title: Here you are.
presence.description: Take one breath. When you're ready, touch your I and feel what's most alive in you right now.

freeze_move.title: Just one stroke.
freeze_move.description: No need for a breath yet. Draw a single line in the circle — any line. That's enough to start coming back.

practice.camera_offer_description: Rest a fingertip over your camera — the rear camera on a phone, or the webcam on a laptop — and watch your pulse move with the breath. It runs entirely on your device. On a laptop, press gently and use bright light (there's no flash).

practice.camera_status_waiting: Rest a fingertip over the camera lens
practice.camera_no_flash_note: No flash on this device — press a fingertip firmly over the lens, in bright light.
practice.camera_coherence_note: Pulse only — coherence unlocks with an Apple Watch.
practice.upgrade_link: In the app with Apple Watch: precise pulse + coherence + the full journey

be_with.description_no_pick: You're bigger than this feeling — it lives within you. Let it rise, and let it settle on its own.
be_with.soak: Your {{shade}} is here — stay with it. Let it fill you.
be_with.soft: Something's there, faint as it is — stay with it.

release.title: You named it — and it's yours.
release.description: That's already enough. You know what to do with it — do it your way, at your pace.

support.title: This seems like a lot right now.
support.description: It can help not to be alone with it. Talking to someone is a strong move, not a weak one.

assimilation.title: You stayed with it.
